footer.aboutBody: DI MI PA BÔS (dimipabos) is an NGO in Guinea-Bissau, based in Bissau, dedicated to transforming lives through shelter, care and essential services.

cta.title: Help Us Build Hope
cta.description: Your contribution is essential to finishing the centre and starting to transform lives. Every brick counts, every bit of help matters.

home.heroSubtitle: A place of shelter and recovery
home.heroDescription: DI MI PA BÔS (dimipabos) is an NGO in Guinea-Bissau building the first specialised treatment and rehabilitation centre for people facing chemical dependency. A space of shelter, care and renewal in Bissau.
home.heroImageAlt: Children and young people supported by DI MI PA BÔS in Guinea-Bissau.
home.cardBody: We work tirelessly to build a space of shelter and recovery, where every person can find the support they need to start again.
home.carouselDescription: A few photos of what our struggle and hope look like.
home.centreDescription: Discover the project that will transform addiction treatment in Guinea-Bissau.

shelter.title: Shelter
shelter.description: Full facilities with dormitories, dining hall, consultation rooms and shared living spaces for up to 20 people.

rehab.title: Rehabilitation
rehab.description: A multidisciplinary team providing specialised medical, psychological and therapeutic support.

reintegration.title: Reintegration
reintegration.description: Post-treatment support with follow-up and care to prevent relapse and ensure lasting recovery.
